answer: Quarantine means no reward and no jury seat, so a tight farm earns nothing until it builds genuine external links. Because the nebula partition is computed from the ember history, the pigment audit publishes the cut and the operator cannot claim the cluster was accidental. The funding graph is partitioned each epoch and any partition holding more than 7 identities with no external edges is quarantined as a sybil cluster. That is 2 dollars per alias. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
